candidate.name: Discontinuously coupled rotor network
candidate.source_variant: Zenodo 1.0.0 or pinned GitHub commit; distinguish smoothed executable model from printed geometry and sharp saturation.
candidate.source_control_scope: Regular and irregular sawtooth oscillations; a narrow period distribution does not certify a periodic full-state orbit.

source_discrepancies: Printed rotor position uses +sin(theta), author code uses -sin(theta); only the latter preserves contact with the stated phase-speed rule.
Printed constant gamma becomes a position-dependent ramp in code; gamma=0 removes this difference.
Printed torque law is sharp, author code applies tanh smoothing with coefficient 40.
Rounded text spacing differs from Fig.5 and code values.
Zenodo defaults gamma=2,time=400; GitHub defaults gamma=3,time=100; both beta=0.
Random initial phases are not seeded.

math.sharp_domain_bound: For alpha>0, beta>0, gamma=0, x0 in [0,N/beta], sharp branch velocity points inward at both endpoints. Wrapped phases yield a compact candidate region conditional on well-defined event solutions.
math.event_caveat: Tangent dynamics must include event-time sensitivity; step/contact convergence is essential. Sharp velocity elimination is not exact for the smoothed code.

priority.source_text_chaos_search: No explicit chaos or Lyapunov diagnosis located in the final main paper and two supplementary PDFs; deterministic irregularity and sensitivity are already reported.
priority.closest_prior: 10.1103/PhysRevE.101.012203 explicitly demonstrates piecewise chaos in related stochastically switched ratchets; exact equivalence not established.
priority.forward_scope: One 2024 sarcomere follow-up preprint and one news record; follow-up checked at metadata/abstract level only.
